content.body: Learn about the shipping services we offer, how pricing is calculated, and what fees to expect—so you always know the cost upfront.

subTabs.label: What services do you offer?
subTabs.title: What services do you offer?
subTabs.body:
We make shipping simple by offering a wide range of delivery solutions designed for every kind of shipper. Whether you’re sending a single package or managing thousands of orders, we’ve got you covered.
  • Domestic Shipping – Fast, coast-to-coast delivery across Canada with trusted carriers.
  • Cross-Border Shipping – Hassle-free U.S. deliveries with discounted rates and smooth customs handling.
  • International Shipping – Reach 200+ countries worldwide with real-time tracking and paperless customs forms.
  • Business Solutions – Tools for e-commerce, bulk shippers, and enterprises to automate workflows and save costs.

No matter the size of your shipment, you’ll always get reliable delivery, transparent rates, and full tracking from start to finish.

subTabs.label: How are fees calculated?
subTabs.title: How are fees calculated?
subTabs.body: Our fees are calculated based on weight, dimensions, destination, and selected shipping options. All rates are displayed upfront.

subTabs.label: Are there hidden charges?
subTabs.title: Are there hidden charges?
subTabs.body: No hidden charges. The total cost includes all fees associated with your shipment.
